turnaround_reason: Charter fell ~49% from $285 to a low of $111 as broadband subscriber losses to fixed-wireless and fiber spooked the market; it now trades at ~3.5x earnings with the transformational Cox merger just closed and heavy insider buying.
bullish_points: Trailing PE ~3.8 / forward ~3.5 — extreme value if free cash flow holds; classic levered-equity call option on stable EBITDA
Cox Communications acquisition completed Aug 20, 2026, adding 6.2M customers and ~$800M targeted operating synergies
Strong insider conviction: CEO Chris Winfrey and Director Wade Davis bought in open market; dossier shows net insider purchases of 1.58M shares over 6 months
12M+ mobile lines growing fast (Spectrum Mobile) provides a convergence bundle to defend broadband and add ARPU
bearish_points: Core broadband is in secular decline: lost 120k internet subs in Q1 2026, worse than the ~100k expected; fixed wireless + fiber overbuild pressure is structural, not cyclical
Extreme leverage (debt/equity ~442, large net debt) means equity is a thin slice; any EBITDA erosion hits the stock hard
Cox integration adds execution and leverage risk on top of an already-levered balance sheet
Some insider divestment noise historically (Rutledge sales); the bull insider signal is recent-CEO-led
catalyst: Cox synergy realization + evidence broadband sub losses are bottoming (convergence bundle stabilizing churn), driving FCF-per-share and deleveraging
catalyst_timing: Q3 2026 earnings (late Oct 2026) — first post-Cox-close print; synergy cadence through 2027
suggested_trade: Small-to-medium spot starter near $145-150; for leverage, Jan 2027/2028 $150 calls (deep, liquid chain) sized as a speculative sleeve
key_risk: Broadband sub losses accelerate rather than stabilize, EBITDA declines against ~4.4x-leveraged balance sheet, and deleveraging thesis breaks
would_skip_if: Next print shows accelerating broadband losses or no sign of churn stabilization from convergence; or Cox integration missteps on synergies
